build_DAPPM_module: build a DAPPM pyramid pooling module for DDRNet with configurable scales and kernel sizes
build_PAPPM_module: build a PAPPM pyramid pooling module for PIDNet with grouped depthwise convolution processing
test_DAPPM_forward: test the DAPPM forward pass by passing a tensor and verifying multi-scale feature fusion output
test_PAPPM_forward: test the PAPPM forward pass by passing a tensor and verifying parallel scale feature aggregation
refactor_DAPPM_to_PAPPM: refactor DAPPM to PAPPM by replacing sequential processes with grouped convolution for parallel processing
